purpose: Turn the backend starter into one safe route per buyer, supplier, and founder action before production implementation begins.
rule: One visible UI action maps to one allowed API route, one production record, and one blocked payment route.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, or booking commission handling in phase one. Buyer pays supplier directly; Heavyster earns paid listing SaaS.

routes.notes: Save selected listing, proof snapshot, supplier route, enquiry note, and response status.
Publish listing, attach proof, choose monthly or annual listing SaaS, and keep rental payment direct.
Review demand, supply, proof, paid listing ARR, and blocked commission rails before scale.

acceptance: Marketplace shows the calm route handoff after the production backend starter.
Buyer route maps Copy enquiry to /api/direct-enquiries and DirectEnquiry while blocking rental payments.
Supplier route maps selected machine publishing to /api/equipment-listings and ListingSubscription while blocking payouts.
Founder route maps market command to /api/market-signals and AdminReview while blocking booking commissions.
Copy text names allowed routes, blocked routes, direct supplier payment, listing SaaS revenue, and 0% rental take.
Build Phase includes the v153 route handoff contract before the Release Ledger.
